events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit location, origin divergence, publish hold
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin && git merge-base --is-ancestor 3caf4d0 main && echo onmain; git merge-base --is-ancestor 3caf4d0 origin/main && echo onorigin; git rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main; grep -n -i "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3; ls cloud/migrations | tail -2; grep -n "T-262" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check recent deploys and worktrees
events.input: $ grep -n "DEPLOYED" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -4 | cut -c1-300; git log --oneline origin/main..main; ls ~/.centre-deploy-wt 2>&1 | head -2; git worktree list | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Create clean worktree and inspect probe usage
events.input: $ git worktree add -q --detach /tmp/wt-t262 main && cd /tmp/wt-t262 && head -40 cloud/scripts/probe-resend-hooks.mjs | grep -n -i -E "sim|port|env|usage|run" | head -15

events.text: The probe starts its own simulator. Install deps and run tsc plus the probe in the clean worktree.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Install deps, typecheck, run Resend hooks probe
events.input: $ cd /tmp/wt-t262/cloud && npm ci --silent >/dev/null 2>&1; echo ci=$?; npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -5; echo tsc=$?; cd /tmp/wt-t262 && node cloud/scripts/probe-resend-hooks.mjs 2>&1 | tail -25

events.name: Bash
events.head: Link app deps, rerun tsc and probe
events.input: $ cd /tmp/wt-t262 && ln -s /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/node_modules app/node_modules && (cd cloud && npx tsc --noEmit -p . >/tmp/t262-tsc.txt 2>&1; echo tsc_exit=$?; wc -l </tmp/t262-tsc.txt) && node cloud/scripts/probe-resend-hooks.mjs > /tmp/t262-probe.txt 2>&1; echo probe_exit=$?; tail -25 /tmp/t262-probe.txt

events.text: All pass. Now push main (2 commits ahead, fast-forward, no force).

events.name: Bash
events.head: Push main to origin without force
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin && git rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main && git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read deploy runbook section
events.input: $ grep -n -A22 "## 3. Deploy the centre Worker" workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md | cut -c1-220; ls /tmp/wt-t262/cloud/public 2>&1 | head -3; git check-ignore cloud/public && echo ignored

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rsync public assets, list pending remote migrations
events.input: $ rsync -a cloud/public/ /tmp/wt-t262/cloud/public/ && ls /tmp/wt-t262/cloud/public | head; cd /tmp/wt-t262/cloud && npx wrangler d1 migrations list revops-centre --remote 2>&1 | tail -6

events.text: No migrations pending, so none applied. Dry run, then deploy.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Dry-run, deploy revops-centre, curl live URL
events.input: $ cd /tmp/wt-t262/cloud && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run 2>&1 | tail -3 && npx wrangler deploy 2>&1 | grep -E -i "version id|deployed|error|https://" | head -6; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/?v=t262"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Remove worktree, append and commit LOG.md line
events.input: $ rm /tmp/wt-t262/app/node_modules && git worktree remove --force /tmp/wt-t262 && echo removed; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord && git status --short | head -5; echo "2026-10-11 · T-262 · DEPLOYED · X032 X033 X109 (3caf4d0) shipped: main pushed at 0d728f7 (8cbbcb2..0d728f7, no force). Worker [redacted] from a clean worktree at 0d728f7, no migration (remote list: none pending). tsc clean; probe-resend-hooks.mjs ALL PASS (16 checks) on the simulator only; resend-domain job not run against any real Resend account. Live root 302." >> LOG.md && git add -- LOG.m

events.text: The LOG.md line is in (the coordination folder isn't a git repo, so there was nothing to commit there). Now the task update.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Set T-262 to review and ack note
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py set T-262 status=review note="Shipped: main pushed at 0d728f7 (includes 3caf4d0, no force) and revops-centre deployed from a clean worktree as Worker [redacted], no migration pending; live root answers 302. In that worktree tsc was clean and probe-resend-hooks.mjs passed all 16 checks against the simulator only (bounce and complaint suppress, forged signature refused, sim log shows DELETE /api-keys/key_full0001); no real Resend account touched." evidence='[{"label":"probe","url":"/Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/scripts/
